sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up portrait against a continuous pale warm-grey mottled photographic/painted background filling every edge, with no card, frame, note, lettering or exterior cutout. A dark-skinned adult man has short dark side hair visible under a white naval peaked cap, dark brows and a clearly visible thick dark upper-lip moustache; his cheeks and chin have no visible beard. The cap has a broad white crown spreading to the top and side crop, a black band and glossy dark visor, a gold braided horizontal strap, and a central dark badge containing a pale anchor and gold leafy decoration. Preserve the badge as actually visible; its tiniest strokes and any rank meaning cannot be resolved or inferred from this156x210 source. He wears a very dark navy jacket with folded lapels, a light blue-grey pointed shirt collar, a straight dark tie, and small gold shoulder details visible near the left/right edges; no invented medals. His head and torso are slightly turned toward screen-left, both eyes are visible and look toward screen-left/slightly upward, and the mouth is closed with a serious neutral expression. One ear is visible at screen-right. Soft light from above/screen-left leaves darker shadows under the cap, nose and chin. Shoulders continue out of both sides and the lower chest is cropped by the bottom. Exact source and nearest4x details actually viewed; original alpha range249-255 retains a visually full continuous rectangle, not transparent background.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up portrait of a dark-skinned adult woman against a continuous muted grey-brown gradient portrait background, darker at the top and lighter behind the lower head, filling the entire rectangle with no card/frame/backing-paper/note layout or exterior cutout. Dark hair is arranged in close rows/braids swept back from the forehead into a compact rounded bun behind the screen-right side of the head. Dark shaped eyebrows, round dark-rimmed spectacles with lighter bronze-coloured temples and reflective lenses, and no visible facial hair. She has no hat. The head is slightly turned toward screen-left with both eyes visible and directed near the viewer; the single mouth is softly parted in a mild composed expression. She wears a muted grey-taupe jacket with broad folded lapels and a rust-red scarf with pale grey circular spots tied at the throat; one wide scarf end extends diagonally across the chest toward screen-right while the other descends near screen-left/centre. Preserve those scarf folds, knot and overlap instead of changing it into a tie or medals. Soft upper-left lighting highlights the forehead, glasses and cheeks. Hair, shoulders and lower garment are cropped as in the source; no hands or additional accessories are visible. Exact156x210 source and nearest4x details actually viewed; minute textile/eyeglass construction cannot be proved beyond visible shapes. Original alpha254-255 is visually full painted backing.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up portrait of a dark-skinned adult woman on a continuous soft dark grey-brown portrait background that fills every edge; no card frame, separate paper, note marks or transparent exterior. Dark hair is brushed back into a small low rounded bun at screen-right, with dark brows and no visible facial hair or eyeglasses. A blue-grey brimmed hat is tilted diagonally downward toward screen-left, with its tall shaped crown reaching the top crop, a wide tan-gold band/visible angular band sections and no clearly visible added badge. Preserve the actual hat silhouette and tilt. She wears a matching muted blue-grey jacket/dress with a broad folded open V collar edged by thin tan-gold piping and one large round gold-brown button at the lower centre crop. There is no tie, scarf or visible medal group. The upper body and face turn slightly toward screen-left, both eyes are visible and gaze near the viewer/screen-left, and the mouth is slightly parted with a calm alert expression. Soft upper-left lighting brightens the forehead/nose/cheeks while the hat shades the upper face; shoulders extend out of the sides and the chest is cropped at the bottom. Exact156x210 source and nearest4x details actually viewed; no inference of tiny hat construction or rank. Original alpha254-255 leaves a visually continuous painted rectangle.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up portrait of a dark-skinned adult woman against a continuous muted dark grey-brown gradient background filling all edges, with no separate card, frame, note or exterior transparency. Dark brown hair forms a short wavy bob with rolled curls at both sides of the jaw/neck. Thin light-metal-framed aviator-like spectacles with dark grey lenses rest on top of her head above the forehead; her actual eyes are unobstructed, so do not move these glasses onto the eyes. Dark brows, no visible facial hair, no hat. Preserve the visibly distinct pale narrow scar/slash marks at the central forehead and the long diagonal/curving scar streaks below the screen-right eye across that cheek; do not erase or turn them into glasses or a beard. She wears a dark brown leather-like jacket with broad lapels over a rust/dark reddish-brown V-opening vest and a cream open pointed-collar shirt with a small light-gold button visible on the lower chest; no necktie, scarf or medal group. The face is nearly frontal but slightly turned toward screen-left, both eyes look near the viewer, and the lips are mildly parted in a composed faint smile. Soft upper-left light highlights the forehead, nose and cheeks; shoulders are cropped at both sides and lower chest at the bottom. Exact156x210 source and nearest4x details actually viewed; the scars and perched spectacles are visible, but microscopic lens/fastener details are not proved. Original alpha254-255 is visually full continuous backing.
